description: Get the full per-retailer offer table for ONE ALLR product in a buyer country: landed cost broken down into item price, shipping, import duty and customs brokerage (plus `tax`; these sum to landed_total. `tax` is 0 for CA and US, and for EU and UK it is the import VAT on cross-border offers, which is included in landed_total), plus stock, condition, per-colorway size availability, whether the retailer ships to that country, and a buy link (an allr.io redirect to the retailer). search_gear only carries the single lowest number. Offers are sorted cheapest landed first and the first `limit` are returned (default 10, max 40; `offer_count` is the total available); a retailer that does not ship to the country is still listed, flagged and sorted last. Availability is truth per (retailer x colorway x size): each offer carries `availability_by_colorway`, one row per colorway with ITS OWN sizes. There is no offer-level size list, because a size in stock in one colorway says nothing about another.

colorway.description: Restrict to offers carrying this colorway. Matched against the product's real colorway NAMES the way the product page matches them: the normalized name first ('matt black' = 'Matt Black'), and only if nothing matches exactly, any colorway whose name contains all of those words as whole words ('black' matches 'Matt Black' AND 'Black/Red'). A value that matches no colorway on this product comes back as an error listing the valid names. When omitted, every colorway is included.

country.description: Buyer country (ISO-2, plus 'EU' and 'UK' as market codes). Determines the currency and the landed cost: item price + shipping + import duty + customs brokerage fee, plus import VAT on cross-border offers for EU and UK. CA and US totals carry no sales tax. ALLR computes landed cost for these four markets only.

include_out_of_stock.description: true includes out-of-stock offers in the table (ALLR does not hide them by default); false returns only in-stock offers.

limit.description: Maximum offers to return, cheapest landed first (1-40, default 10). `offer_count` is the total and `has_more` says whether more offers exist beyond this limit.

product_id.description: ALLR product id from search_gear, or a full https://allr.io/product/<id> URL, or the bare slug. A merged/renamed id is followed to its canonical product automatically.

size.description: Restrict to offers that have this size IN STOCK in at least one colorway, e.g. 'L', 'XL', '44'. The kept offers carry `matched_colorways` — exactly the colorways that have it. Combined with `colorway`, the offer must have that size IN that colorway. An offer with no per-colorway breakdown is dropped by this filter rather than guessed at.

vat_country.description: Only with country='EU': the buyer's EU member state (ISO-2, e.g. 'DE', 'HU'; 'EL' also accepted for Greece). Import VAT on cross-border offers is then charged at that state's standard rate (17% to 27%); a store that prices by destination VAT is re-priced for it. Omitted or not an EU member state: 21% reference rate.

name: get_product_offers

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which these prices were assembled.

has_more.description: true when more offers exist than `limit` returned; `limit` accepts up to 40.

offer_count.description: Total offers for this product/country after filters (may exceed the number returned in `offers`).

availability_by_colorway.description: Per-colorway stock: one row per colorway, each carrying ONLY that colorway's in-stock sizes. Rows are independent: a size present in one colorway is not in stock in another. An EMPTY sizes_in_stock means that colorway has nothing in stock at this retailer. null means ALLR cannot attribute sizes to colorways for this offer; `availability_note` says why.

colorway.description: Colorway display name; null only when the retailer names no colorway.

sizes_in_stock.description: Sizes in stock IN THIS COLORWAY at this retailer.

availability_note.description: Set only when `availability_by_colorway` is null — the reason ALLR cannot break this offer's stock down by colorway.

brokerage.description: Courier / post customs-clearance fee in `currency`; 0 when the parcel needs no clearance, the retailer is domestic or same-customs-zone, or the price is delivered-duty-paid. It is charged only where a carrier advances duty or import VAT. Canada: greater of CA$12.00 or 3.7% of duty plus HST for a courier (CA$9.95 per item for Canada Post), whenever duty OR tax is collected. US: greater of US$17.50 or 2.5% of duty (DHL/FedEx US; UPS US is unpublished and priced the same). UK: 0 up to GBP 135 (VAT collected at sale), above that the greater of GBP 12.00 or 2.5% of duty plus import VAT (DHL UK default; FedEx 12.90, UPS 13.60 at 3%, Royal Mail 8). EU (non-EU sellers): the EUR 2 Union handling fee on every parcel plus the greater of EUR 15 or 2.5% of duty plus import VAT (FedEx EU default; UPS 15.70 at 3%, DHL 12.50 at 2%). No VAT is added on the fee.

brokerage_basis.description: Which brokerage rule produced `brokerage`, e.g. 'ups-ca', 'default-dhl-us', 'uk-under-135', 'default-dhl-uk', 'eu-uhf+default-fedex', 'ddp', 'same-zone'. A 'default-' prefix means the retailer's courier is not known and the destination default was used; '-unproven' means the carrier's published amount could not be found.

buy_url.description: An allr.io redirect to the retailer's product page; it counts the click.

colorways.description: Colorways this offer covers (display names, as the product page shows them). Narrowed to the requested colorway when `colorway` was given.

condition.description: null = new. Otherwise 'Open Box', 'Blemished', 'B-Stock', 'Refurbished' or 'Discontinued'. ALLR shows at most one offer per (retailer, condition).

domestic.description: true when the retailer sells domestically in `country` (no import duty).

duty_basis.description: How `duty` was priced: 'mfn' (full most-favoured-nation rate), 'ceta' / 'cuktca' / 'cusma' (0% preference, only when ALLR has the product's country of manufacture on file and the parcel ships from that partner), or 'origin-unknown-mfn' (Canada: the full MFN rate is quoted because the product's origin is not on file).

duty_note.description: Short caveat printed beside the duty on allr.io, e.g. 'Duty may be $0 if made in the EU (CETA)'. Present only on Canadian offers from EU or UK stores that pay MFN duty because the product's origin is unknown; null otherwise.

landed_total.description: Item + shipping + duty + brokerage + tax in `currency`. `tax` is 0 for CA and US and import VAT for cross-border EU and UK offers. null when the retailer cannot ship to this country.

list_price_foreign.description: The retailer's own price in its own currency, before conversion.

matched_colorways.description: When `colorway` and/or `size` was requested: exactly the colorways of this offer that satisfied the request (for a size filter, the colorways that have that size). null when no such filter was applied.

note.description: Human-readable caveat, e.g. 'Does not ship to CA'.

observed_at.description: When ALLR last saw this offer.

shipping_estimated.description: true when the shipping figure is ALLR's estimate rather than a retailer-quoted rate.

sizes_listed.description: Every size the retailer lists for this offer, in stock or not, across all of its colorways. This is a LISTING-level array and says nothing per colorway — per-colorway stock is in availability_by_colorway.

tax.description: Import VAT. 0 for CA and US (ALLR does not include destination sales tax; the retailer shows it at checkout). For EU and UK, the import VAT on cross-border offers (UK 20%; EU: the buyer's own member state's rate, 17% to 27%, 21% when `vat_country` is not given; 0 on helmets sold by UK and EU shops into the UK), included in landed_total; 0 for domestic and same-zone offers.

colorways.description: Colorway names ALLR recognises for this product.

redirected_from.description: Set when the requested id was a merged duplicate and was followed to this canonical product.

title: Get every retailer offer for a product
